notes.title: Bug Fixes Update
notes.content:
This patch focuses on improving stability, UI adjustments, and bug fixes. Please make sure you have the latest (windows 1.0.4.275, macOS 1.0.4.57) version of the game! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891098/c47158cd52ddea1d148c97ad648f5344a82ec56b.jpg[/img]

[b]List of changes: [/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with UI scaling and font sizes for Steam Deck users and and made several UI adjustments for better readability. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the foreground of the station was not transparent after loading a save. 
[*] Fixed an issue where existing quests could be re-added [spoiler](e.g. after speaking with Major Sargos in the VIP carriage)[/spoiler]. 
[*] Fixed an issue with the train route map displaying incorrectly. 
[*] Fixed an issue where players could initiate a conversation with the celebrity [spoiler]before they reached the dining car[/spoiler]. 
[*] Fixed an issue where items could be duplicated through save/load manipulation. 
[*] Fixed an issue with card game animations. 
[*] Fixed an issue with misaligned sitting animations at the dining tables. 
[*] Fixed an issue with localization in several languages. 
[/list]
Thank you for staying on duty, conductors! Keep reporting bugs and suspicious activity — your efforts help us keep everything running smoothly. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2825530/Beholder_Conductor/

notes.title: Bug Fixes Update
notes.content:
We’re releasing a new update focused on important bug fixes and stability improvements. Thank you for your vigilance and support, conductors – please make sure you have the latest version (windows 1.0.3.265, macOS 1.0.3.52) of the game! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891098/4d9ecccfe1482a5c03e4158473bc7602e5a1778d.jpg[/img]

[b]List of changes: [/b]

[list]
[*] Added a new quest to the first-class carriage. To trigger the quest, you should have a save from the Fuersten (or earlier) station. [spoiler]Ensure that both foreign passengers, Bekir Shakhin and Elif Beyaz, are not arrested and are sitting in their compartment. If all conditions are met, the phone will ring after departing from the Pients station [/spoiler]. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the game could freeze after the intro video, preventing players from starting a new game. 
[*] Fixed an issue where two dialogues could start simultaneously during the final part of the game. 
[*] Fixed an issue with the visibility of first-class passenger [spoiler]bodies[/spoiler] when peeking into compartments [spoiler]after the shelling event[/spoiler]. 
[*] Fixed an issue where players were incorrectly fined for an unchecked ticket. 
[*] Fixed an issue with incorrect reputation and money deductions during the final part of the game. 
[*] Fixed the audio balance between voice and music in the intro video and several endings. 
[*] Fixed several localization errors across different languages. 
[/list]
Thank you for staying alert, conductors! 
Keep reporting any suspicious activity and bugs to help us keep the journey smooth and steady. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2825530/Beholder_Conductor/

notes.title: Balance Update & New side quests
notes.content:
We've been carefully reviewing your reports. This update brings fixes, balance tweaks, and even a few new mini quests for our most privileged passengers. Make sure you have the latest version (windows 1.0.2.253, macOS 1.0.2.49) of the game! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891098/39b9c736c725239c7f5b9bf6421c43e0bd741ca5.jpg[/img]

[b]List of changes: [/b]

[list]
[*] Added 3 new mini-quests to the VIP carriage. These quests are available from the Agloe station or earlier saves. 
[*] Added a new dialogue option when talking to a member of “New Tomorrow”, [spoiler]allowing you to attempt calling security[/spoiler]. 
[*] Changed the “family brooch” questline. This item will remain in the lost-and-found box [spoiler]if all of its owners are arrested[/spoiler].
[*] Changed the balance of third-class luggage.  
[*] Increased the duration of an in-game hour to improve pacing. 
[*] Adjusted pricing and rewards balance in the first-class and VIP carriages. 
[*] Fixed an issue with the “Eliminate Colt” quest [spoiler]where Henry Colt would respawn after dying[/spoiler]. 
[*] Fixed an issue when dialogues with old conductor Bart at the beginning of the game didn’t disappear after being viewed. 
[*] Fixed an issue with the arrest logic for the “noisy passengers”. They no longer return to their compartment 
[/list]
Thank you for staying alert, conductors. Keep reporting suspicious activity and bugs to help us keep this train running on schedule! 
 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2825530/Beholder_Conductor/

notes.title: First Update is Here
notes.content:
Our first patch for Beholder: Conductor has arrived! Based on your [url=https://support.alawar.com/beholder_conductor_en]reports[/url], we’ve made several important fixes and adjustments to make your conductor duties smoother and more efficient. Thanks for keeping an eye on the issues — the Ministry appreciates your loyalty. Please, make sure that you have the latest (windows v1.0.1.246, MacOS v1.0.1.41) version of the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891098/0c0db65d1992111ff1f067d22287e2d7e8c9da12.jpg[/img]

[b]List of changes: [/b]

[list]
[*] Adjusted the timing of the quest marker in the “Find the Ambassador” mission to make it clearer when the story is progressing — now players will receive clearer guidance on what to do next. 
[*] Added additional tutorial instructions explaining how the supply system works, as well as how and why to use time acceleration and the pause function. 
[*] Fixed an exploit that allowed players to farm money by reselling items at a profit. 
[*] Fixed localization issues across multiple languages for a more seamless experience. 
[/list]
Thank you for boarding Beholder: Conductor! 
Keep reporting any suspicious activity and bugs to help us keep this train running on schedule. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2825530/Beholder_Conductor/

notes.title: Beholder: Conductor — Release Date Reveal
notes.content:
Citizens, 

You have been summoned to serve. 
Your mission starts on [b]April 23rd[/b], when you will assume your duties as a senior Conductor aboard the legendary train — the Determination Bringer. Please arrive on time. 

[previewyoutube=xwIS1SPvQoA;full][/previewyoutube]
The train is preparing for a long and thrilling journey across the country. 
Your responsibilities include readying the compartments, welcoming the passengers, and enforcing order throughout the route. You will meet people from all corners of the nation. Hear their stories. And decide — who deserves to ride on, and who will be removed from the train.  

As your loyalty to the Ministry deepens, you will unlock access to secret missions that offer rewards and opportunities for promotion. But beware – the journey is filled with risks, including encounters with smugglers, bribery, and corruption. Your choices will shape the lives of passengers — and the course of history, leading to multiple endings. 

[b]Please review and comply with the Ministry’s directives: [/b]
[list]
[*] Monitor all passengers 
[*] Report their actions and file misconduct notices 
[*] Conduct baggage searches (preferably unnoticed) 
[*] Rise through the ranks… or come under investigation 
[/list]
The ticket price will be disclosed on departure day. New conductors will receive 10% off during the first 10 days after launch.

The Ministry relies on your loyalty

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2825530/Beholder_Conductor  

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/alawar][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891098/92832aabb467c3b70c6f9f9eef3cf5bf8bd7d88f.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: First details of Beholder: Conductor
notes.content:
Attention citizens! Top-secret information has leaked from the Ministry of Secret Developments!  

Information for future conductors of the “Determination Bringer” train: 

[list]
[*] The events of Beholder: Conductor unfold in [b]parallel[/b] with Beholder (2016). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891098/bdc8a27e54ebfa3ae8aace03ae4e5ab8d143e720.png[/img]
[*] Your decisions will influence the course of the multiple-endings story. 
[*] For the first time in the Beholder series, you will see an authentic map of its world. 
[*] Your journey will take you to various railway stations throughout the Great State, including Agloe, a city under Valverde's occupation. 
[*] As a Senior Conductor, you will confront numerous dangers and threats to order, including the formidable revolutionary group known as the New Tomorrow. 
[*] The search of hidden places will become more interactive, requiring direct player involvement. 
[*] Prepare to meet a range of new characters and reunite with some familiar faces. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891098/ce042072eb7fbe25b510b116f911f01c295aabb2.png[/img]
[/list]

We're counting on you, conductor! With all the tools at your disposal, it's up to you to uphold loyalty, justice, and order – wield them wisely. 

Add the game to your wishlist now and stay updated on all news and announcements about Beholder: Conductor! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2825530/Beholder_Conductor/

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/alawar]Discord[/url] server to connect with fellow citizens and discuss your expectations for the upcoming journey. 🚂
